scope: Read-only pixel-level physics verification of embedded GeoTIFF band descriptions in training_features.tif. No model fitting, feature cache mutation, surface construction, or dot placement.

band6_tc_verification.embedded_header_description: tc - Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
band6_tc_verification.true_physical_quantity: USGS GeoDAWN Airborne Gamma-Ray Spectrometry Total Count (TC, dose rate)

gravity_derivative_vector_verification.band5_embedded_header: iso_grav_anom_slope - Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction
gravity_derivative_vector_verification.band11_embedded_header: iso_grav_anom_vg - Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change
gravity_derivative_vector_verification.band18_embedded_header: iso_grav_anom_hg - Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change

true_physical_identities.band11_iso_grav_anom_vg: +d(Band 13 iso_grav_anom)/drow_south = -d(Band 13 iso_grav_anom)/dy_north (signed North-South horizontal derivative, NOT vertical gradient dg/dz)
true_physical_identities.band5_iso_grav_anom_slope: sqrt(Band 11^2 + Band 18^2) (scalar 2-D horizontal gravity gradient magnitude)
true_physical_identities.laplace_vertical_second_derivative_ident: g_zz = -(d(Band 18)/dx_east - d(Band 11)/dy_north) via Laplace's equation div_3D(g) = 0 in the source-free upper half-space

laplace_gzz_multiscale_verification.physical_note: Unregularized 100 m (sigma=0) second derivatives amplify resampling-grid interpolation noise of regional gravity (r=0.4364), and unmasked -3.4028e38 nodata boundaries corrupt Gaussian tails; masking nodata and regularizing at sigma=400-600 m (4-6 px) recovers true Laplace g_zz with r=0.8627-0.9149.
